tasks.title: Core Database Schema
tasks.description: Create all Phase 1 database tables: members, wallets, wallet_transactions, products, swarms, combs, draws, email_notifications, admin_staff, regions. Extends existing users table with member-specific columns.

tasks.title: Member Auth — Registration, Login, Region Assignment
tasks.description: Extend existing AuthService and AuthController to support member registration with home_region selection, email verification flag, and member role. Add logout endpoint. Member JWT payload includes region and role.

tasks.title: Admin Auth — Staff Login and Session
tasks.description: Create separate admin authentication system for staff accounts with admin_staff table. Admin JWT payload carries staff role (super_admin, admin, staff). Admin routes protected by AdminAuthMiddleware.

tasks.title: Security Review — Auth Systems
tasks.description: Security audit of Task 2 and Task 3: member auth, admin auth, JWT payloads, role enforcement, brute-force protections, session isolation between member and admin surfaces.

tasks.title: Nectar Wallet API
tasks.description: Build wallet read endpoints and internal wallet mutation service. Implements two-bucket system (deposit_balance, bonus_balance), spend-bonus-first deduction logic, and refund-to-source logic. No payment processing in this task — wallet state management only.

tasks.title: Stripe Top-Up Integration
tasks.description: Stripe Checkout integration for Nectar top-up. Implements the five top-up tiers with correct deposit and bonus Nectar amounts. Stripe webhook handler credits wallet on payment_intent.succeeded. Withdrawal request submission endpoint.

tasks.title: Security Review — Wallet and Payment
tasks.description: Security audit of Task 5 and Task 6: two-bucket integrity, bonus non-withdrawable enforcement, Stripe webhook signature verification, idempotency key handling, withdrawal request validation.

tasks.title: Product Catalog API
tasks.description: Admin-only CRUD for the product catalog. Endpoints for create, read, update products with image upload support. Products have: name, brand, category, retail_value, description, images JSON, times_used counter.

tasks.title: Swarm Engine API
tasks.description: Core swarm lifecycle API. Create, publish, read, and status-transition endpoints for swarms. Implements Comb purchase endpoint with wallet deduction (bonus-first), per-member Comb limit enforcement, live odds calculation, and fill detection trigger. Comb purchase is the critical write path.

tasks.title: Draw Mechanism and Refund Engine
tasks.description: Random.org API integration triggered automatically when a swarm fills. Stores tamper-proof draw result with Random.org verification URL. Implements the deadline-expiry cron job that auto-refunds all Combs to source buckets when a swarm expires unfilled. Implements manual cancel flow with full refund.

tasks.title: Email Notification System
tasks.description: Email notification service triggered by swarm lifecycle events: swarm launch announcement, filling warning (threshold reached), win confirmation to winner, refund notice on expiry, withdrawal status updates. Uses queued email_notifications table for reliability.

tasks.title: Security Review — Swarm Engine and Payments
tasks.description: Security audit of Tasks 8–11: Comb purchase race condition handling (optimistic lock on swarm fill), Random.org API key protection, refund idempotency, file upload validation for product images, admin-only route enforcement.

tasks.title: Region Routing System
tasks.description: URL-based /ca/ /us/ region routing middleware. TLD-to-region redirect logic (honeycolm.ca → /ca/, honeycolm.com → /ca/ pre-US-launch). Region cookie management. Member home-region lock enforcement on all Comb purchase attempts.

tasks.title: Member-Facing Frontend Shell and Design System
tasks.description: Global HTML shell for the member-facing site: nav bar (logo placeholder, links, region switcher, wallet balance for logged-in state, login/join CTA for logged-out), footer (logo, nav, region note, Random.org badge), trust bar, honeycomb SVG pattern component, CSS design tokens (all brand colours, typography, button styles, card styles, badges, progress bars, countdown timer), offline banner. Shared across all member pages.

tasks.title: Homepage
tasks.description: Homepage HTML, JS controller, and CSS. Hero section (tagline, subheadline, CTA), How It Works 3-step explainer, active Swarms preview grid (4 swarm cards max, live data), Past Winners preview strip, trust bar. Implements SwarmCard reusable component with progress bar, live odds, countdown timer.

tasks.title: Active Swarms Browse Page
tasks.description: Active Swarms browse page. Full grid of live swarms with filter bar (category, price range, time remaining). SwarmCard component reused. Offline-capable via IndexedDB cache of swarm list. Implements App.Controllers.ActiveSwarmsController.

tasks.title: Swarm Detail Page
tasks.description: Swarm detail page: product images gallery, product name/description/retail value, live Combs remaining progress bar, live odds display, countdown timer, Comb purchase form (quantity selector, Nectar balance check, Enter Swarm CTA), draw callout (Random.org trust copy), past winner section if draw complete. Comb purchase calls API and updates IndexedDB. Implements App.Controllers.SwarmDetailController.

tasks.title: How It Works, Past Winners, and FAQ Pages
tasks.description: Three static-content member pages. How It Works: full step-by-step explainer with brand vocabulary. Past Winners: paginated list of draw results (winner first name, location, item, draw date, Random.org link). FAQ: accordion-style, addresses legality, odds, Nectar, refunds using exact brand copy from spec. All three pages share member shell from Task 14.

tasks.title: Member Account Dashboard
tasks.description: Protected member account dashboard: entered swarms list with Combs held and live odds, win history, account settings (name, email, password change). Requires auth guard redirect to login if no JWT. Implements App.Controllers.AccountDashboardController with IndexedDB offline read of cached swarm entries.

tasks.title: Nectar Wallet and Top-Up Page
tasks.description: Member Nectar wallet page: display deposit balance and bonus balance separately (bonus clearly labelled non-withdrawable), transaction history, top-up tier selector (5 tiers with bonus callout), Stripe Checkout launch button, withdrawal request form (deposit balance only, minimum Nt 10). Implements App.Controllers.NectarWalletController.

tasks.title: Admin Panel Shell and Design System
tasks.description: Admin panel global shell: left sidebar navigation (desktop, collapses to icon strip on tablet), header bar with staff name and logout, admin-specific CSS design tokens sharing brand palette but with admin layout conventions. Separate HTML entry point at /admin/index.html. Admin auth guard (redirect to /admin/login.html if no admin JWT). Honeycomb pattern applied at low opacity to sidebar.

tasks.title: Admin Dashboard Page
tasks.description: Admin dashboard page: platform overview stat cards (total members, active swarms, total Nectar in circulation, pending withdrawals), active swarms at-a-glance table, recent activity feed. All data from API. Implements App.Controllers.Admin.DashboardController.

tasks.title: Admin Swarm Management Pages
tasks.description: Three admin swarm pages: (1) Swarm list — full table with status filters and search; (2) Create New Swarm 3-step flow — Step 1 product picker, Step 2 parameters with auto-calculated margin, Step 3 review and publish with margin warning threshold; (3) Swarm detail admin view — live stats, Comb holders table, draw result, shipping status update. Implements App.Controllers.Admin.SwarmManagementController.

tasks.title: Admin Product Catalog Page
tasks.description: Admin product catalog page: searchable/browsable product grid, add new product modal (all catalog fields, image upload), edit existing product modal. Connects to Task 8 API. Implements App.Controllers.Admin.ProductCatalogController.

tasks.title: Admin Member Management Pages
tasks.description: Admin member management: searchable member list table, member detail page (account info, wallet balances, transaction history, entered swarms, admin actions — deactivate/reactivate). Implements App.Controllers.Admin.MemberManagementController.

tasks.title: Admin Withdrawal, Draw, and Finance Pages
tasks.description: Three admin operational pages: (1) Withdrawal management — pending and processed withdrawal requests, approve/reject with notes; (2) Draw management — draw log with Random.org verification links, shipping status tracker; (3) Nectar and Finance Overview — revenue, margin, top-up volume by processor, withdrawal totals. Implements App.Controllers.Admin.WithdrawalController, DrawController, FinanceController.

tasks.title: Admin Settings Page
tasks.description: Admin settings page: staff account management (create/edit/deactivate staff), region management (toggle US market on/off, set honeycolm.com default region), Random.org API key configuration, platform-wide config (margin warning threshold, filling-fast threshold percentage). Implements App.Controllers.Admin.SettingsController.

tasks.title: SEO — Member-Facing Pages
tasks.description: Meta tags, Open Graph, JSON-LD schema markup, canonical URLs, and hreflang for all member-facing pages. Homepage, Active Swarms, Swarm Detail (product schema), How It Works, Past Winners, FAQ (FAQPage schema). Region-aware canonical URLs using /ca/ path prefix.

tasks.title: Documentation — API Contract and WHAT_EXISTS Registry
tasks.description: Write complete docs/api.md with all endpoints from Tasks 2–13. Write docs/WHAT_EXISTS.md registering all created tables, classes, routes, and JS namespaces. Update docs/AGENT_CONTEXT.md to status COMPLETE.
